issues.fix: 11_exterior.js l.447-456: start the loft at x 1.55 and let height and width both grow from about zero with a round (sqrt) profile, so the nose is a dome. const nose = Math.sqrt(smooth(1.55, 2.3, x)); ridge = nacTop(x) + 0.70 * Math.pow(smooth(1.55, leE - E.x0, x), 0.55) * lerp(0.35, 1, nose) (drop the 0.15 offset); w = (...) * lerp(0.12, 1, nose); bot = nacTop(x) - 0.30 * lerp(0.3, 1, nose), so the nose section sinks into the cowl. Use k <= 24 with x = lerp(1.55, 10.6, Math.pow(k/24, 1.3)) to put more rings in the nose. Optional, for the _137 saddle: ridge -= 0.12 * Math.exp(-((x - 4.2) / 0.6) ** 2).
